title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrell Jennings works out for Patriots
items.desc: Free agent Terrell Jennings worked out for the Patriots on Friday.
items.impact: Jennings was one of three running backs to work out for New England.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) undergoes further testing
items.desc: Elijah Arroyo underwent further testing on Friday.
items.impact: Arroyo suffered the injury in Thursday's game against the Broncos. There should be an update on him by next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ben Bartch (foot) placed on IR
items.desc: The Lions placed Ben Bartch on injured reserve with a foot injury.
items.impact: Bartch will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tytus Howard (knee) will play Sunday
items.desc: Tytus Howard (knee) will play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Howard missed practice earlier in the week due to a knee issue, but it's no longer an issue for him and won't prevent him from playing in Week 6. Cleveland's offensive line will be stronger with him in the lineup against Baltimore.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tylan Wallace (knee) available to play Sunday
items.desc: Tylan Wallace (knee) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Wallace will be good to go on Sunday, despite being listed with a knee injury at practice earlier in the week. He is unlikely to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Parkinson closed the week with a full practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Denzel Boston (foot) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Denzel Boston (foot) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, despite dealing with a foot injury at practice throughout the week. He has been good through the first five weeks of the season and can safely be started in most league formats at this point.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Higbee off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Higbee is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Higbee will be good to go despite not practicing on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Vorhees (foot) questionable for Week 6
items.desc: Andrew Vorhees (foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Vorhees is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he's still dealing with a foot issue of some kind. If he's sidelined, the interior of Baltimore's offensive line will be weakened with Cam Jurgens (concussion) also out and Emery Jones Jr. (ankle) questionable for Week 6.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Davis Allen (foot) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Davis Allen is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Allen remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kam Curl (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Kam Curl is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Curl did not practice on Friday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Gillikin (back) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Blake Gillikin is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Gillikin was added to the injury report on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) active for Sunday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) will be active for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The veteran lineman will be available to play on Sunday, despite being a non-participant at Thursday's practice due to his groin issue. He should continue to be a solid starter for the Ravens moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kitan Crawford (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Kitan Crawford is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Crawford will have a chance to be activated from injured reserve on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zaven Collins (hip) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Zaven Collins is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Collins was added to the injury report for Friday. His status is uncertain for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Budda Baker (rest/groin) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Budda Baker is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Baker did not practice on Wednesday or Friday this week. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Wingard (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Wingard has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Wingard remained sidelined from practice all week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Wydett Williams Jr. (concussion) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Wydett Williams Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Williams will be sidelined in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Marcus Ingram listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ja'Marcus Ingram is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Ingram will be a game-time decision on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Henry To'oTo'o (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Henry To'oTo'o is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: To'oTo'o had his practice window opened this week. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The rookie will have a chance to make his return to the field after missing several games while on injured reserve. The team will make a determination about his availability closer to game time, and fantasy managers should temper expectations for him this week, especially with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined against Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Romello Height (hand) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Romello Height did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Height remains uncertain for Monday's game against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Thompson Jr. (ankle) practices Friday
items.desc: James Thompson Jr. was at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Thompson is on track to return from his ankle injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Nick Bosa remained absent from practice on Friday.
items.impact: Bosa will need to practice in some capacity on Saturday to have a chance to return for Monday's game against the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Roger Rosengarten (knee) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Roger Rosengarten (knee) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Baltimore will have their starting right tackle on Sunday, as Rosengarten has been cleared to play, despite still dealing with a knee issue. Their offensive line will be at close to full health this week, except for Cam Jurgens (concussion) being sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Thomas returned to a limited practice on Friday. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) available to play Sunday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Stanley is going to play on Sunday. He was held out of Baltimore's practice on Friday, but that was just for load management purposes and he should play at full capacity on Sunday, which is good news for the entire Ravens' offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Nubin (neck) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Nubin has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Nubin was sidelined from practice all week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Theo Johnson (neck) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Theo Johnson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Johnson did not practice on Friday. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (toe) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (toe) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Baltimore's star wide receiver will be available to play on Sunday, despite still dealing with a minor toe injury of some kind. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him this week, although his ceiling will be considerably lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined for another week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colton Hood (concussion) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Colton Hood has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Hood will be sidelined as he remains in concussion protocol.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Bateman is going to be good to go for Sunday's game, despite missing practice on Thursday due to a shoulder issue. He should be a full go but doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option in this matchup against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jermaine Eluemunor is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Eluemunor returned to a limited practice on Friday. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Abdul Carter (calf) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Abdul Carter is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Carter returned to a limited practice on Friday. It gives him a chance to be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Wood (calf) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Zach Wood is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Wood was a full participant in practice all week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Spears is uncertain to play on Sunday. He is managing a nagging knee issue of some kind right now, but he was able to log a full practice on Friday still, which is a good sign that he will play through it. He will be worth keeping an eye on in this matchup if active, as he saw high involvement in the team's passing game last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lorenzo Styles Jr. (knee) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Lorenzo Styles Jr. is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Styles was limited in practice to end the week. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nathan Shepherd (illness) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Nathan Shepherd is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Shepherd returned to a limited practice on Friday after being sidelined due to an illness.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Martin-Robinson (hamstring) will play Sunday
items.desc: David Martin-Robinson (hamstring) will play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: A hamstring injury left Martin-Robinson limited at practice earlier in the week, but it's no longer an issue for him and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future with how bad Tennessee's offense is playing, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amani Hooker (concussion) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Amani Hooker (concussion) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Hooker has finally cleared the NFL's concussion protocols and will be back in the lineup on Sunday. His return will offer a nice boost to Tennessee's secondary moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) returns to practice Friday
items.desc: Ed Oliver was back at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Oliver did not practice on Thursday. His status will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Dulin is not going to be available to play on Sunday, which comes as no surprise, given that his hamstring injury left him sidelined at practice all week. His absence may lead to a bit more work for Keenan Allen against the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) in non-contact jersey Friday in practice
items.desc: DJ Moore was in a non-contact jersey in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Moore returned to practice, but in limited fashion. His status will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Downs (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Josh Downs (hamstring) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Downs will be available to play on Sunday, despite popping up on Indianapolis' injury report earlier in the week with a hamstring issue. Look for him to see a large portion of Indianapolis' passing work against the Titans on Sunday, especially if Tyler Warren (groin) is ruled out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Wicks returned to a full practice on Friday after he missed practice on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eli Stowers (quad) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Eli Stowers is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Stowers remains off the fantasy radar if he makes his return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Steen (shoulder) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Steen is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Steen is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Mukuba (shoulder) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Mukuba is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Mukuba will be a full-go for Sunday against Carolina.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) now questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Warren (groin) is now questionable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Warren is a surprise addition to Indianapolis' injury report. He seems to have aggravated his groin late in the practice week and was limited on Friday, and it may very well leave him sidelined in Week 6. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next couple of days and should have a backup option ready in case the young tight end is ruled out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fred Johnson (knee) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Fred Johnson is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Johnson will be a full-go for Sunday against Carolina.
